| infl.      | class        | meaning         |

| ~          | *n.*         | ice, (the cold) |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- pictograph of a snowflake (not a star)
- sitelen pona for "lete"
- maybe influenced by 氷
#### Sound
- *a priori:* ch=sharp, u=deep/melancholy
